dimension_c_md.title: Prepare WF-51 Payload reads trigger node twice with different accessor styles
dimension_c_md.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-46.md — Prepare WF-51 Payload jsCode: `const user = $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.user` then `const trigger = $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json` — two references to the same trigger node, different methods (.item.json vs .first().json)
dimension_c_md.recommended_action: Collapse to a single `const input = $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json; const user = input.user;` pattern for consistency with sibling WFs (WF-42 / WF-33). No functional bug — both accessors return the same item.
